statement: Let w(c)=widths[c-97] for a lowercase byte c, and for 0<=l<=r<=len(s) let W(l,r)=sum_{t=l}^{r-1} w(s[t]). Define p_0=0. For each j with p_j<len(s), let p_{j+1} be the largest integer q such that p_j<q<=len(s) and W(p_j,q)<=100. Let k be the least integer with p_k=len(s). Then the function returns a result r with len(r)=2, r[0]=k, and r[1]=W(p_{k-1},len(s)).
preconditions: len(widths)=26; for every i with 0<=i<26, 2<=widths[i]<=10; 1<=len(s)<=1000; and every byte s[t] with 0<=t<len(s) is a lowercase English letter (97<=s[t]<=122).
